name: Rubescent-Mastaba

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: They dwell in pressure-keeps beneath the ice, mining heat from the mantle seams.

description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by an ancient meteor crater, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Signal chatter rises from the inhabited zones, structured, rhythmic, and unmistakably deliberate.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Mining charters include clauses about 'subsurface events' that lawyers refuse to define.
